description: This file is a device driver implementation for the HIP9011/TPIC8101 chip, including SPI communication setup, hardware initialization, and control functions for engine knock detection and related diagnostics. It manages SPI exchanges, hardware configuration, and scheduling of trigger events to monitor knock within an engine management system.

classes.name: Hip9011Hardware
classes.description: Implements hardware communication interface for HIP9011 device, providing methods to send synchronized and regular SPI commands.

methods.name: sendSyncCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to HIP9011 with synchronization to ensure correct timing, then pauses briefly.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous command to HIP9011 over SPI.
